QuestInfo.name: Yesterday's Enemy, Today's Sitting Duck
QuestInfo.0: You've got another mission. Talk to #bGen#k about it.
QuestInfo.1: Whatever shady dealings Mr. Hazard is up to are probably recorded in his secret account.\r\nSince #bPopoh#k seems to know his way around, he ought to tag along.
QuestInfo.2: You and Popoh made it to the Abandoned Building!

0.0: It seems like Mr. Hazard was dealing with a lot of partners that the Shadowdealers didn't exactly approve of.\r\n
0.1: I've heard talk that the High Flora were some of his best customers. He's the one who gave them Vision Bomb tech.\r\n
0.2: But those are just rumors. If we want to know what really happened, we need to break into his base and get his papers.\r\n
0.3: And by us, I mean you. I got to squeeze all the use out of you that I can.\r\n

yes.0: Oh, and I'm giving you a new partner for this one. Coney says our, heh, 'new recruit' has a good sense of smell.\r\n

1.msg: You survived, little puff?! I don't know about this. Can this thing really handle a dangerous mission?\r\n

3.msg: I guess that means yes. Okay. Let's see what you're made of.\r\n

4.msg: Let's take a look around Mr. Hazard's old digs. Lead the way, puff!\r\n#r (You will automatically move to the relevant field.)#k

default.0: Oh, and I'm giving you a new partner from this one. I hear our, heh, 'new recruit' has a good sense of smell.\r\n
